title: Eliminating Full Table Scans Under Concurrency
prompt: A payment settlement service queries a 180M-row PostgreSQL 16 `orders_ledger` table (240 GB heap) using `WHERE merchant_id = $1 AND status = 'PENDING_SETTLEMENT' ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 50`. Only `PRIMARY KEY (order_id)` and an index on `(created_at)` exist. During peak payout windows (2,400 QPS), p99 latency jumps from 12 ms to 14.8 s, NVMe read IOPS hit the 16,000 IOPS ceiling, `shared_buffers` (32 GB) thrash, and all 500 HikariCP connections block. Design the remediation and long-term guardrails without causing table-write downtime.
